claim.claim-text: 1. A connector (3), comprising an anchoring portion and a functional portion rigidly connected to the anchoring portion, wherein the anchoring portion comprises thermoplastic material in a solid state, wherein the functional portion defines a coupling-in-face, wherein the connector (3) is equipped for being anchored in an object (1) by mechanical vibration and a pressing force being coupled into the connector (3) via the coupling-in face while the anchoring portion extends into the object (1), which vibration and pressing force are transferred into the anchoring portion until a flow portion of the anchoring portion is flowable and pressed into structures of the object (1), whereby, after re-solidification of the flow portion, the anchoring portion is anchored in the object (1) by a positive-fit connection, wherein the functional portion comprises a functional structure.
2. The connector according to claim 1, wherein the functional structure is arranged asymmetrically with respect to a proximodistal insertion axis.
3. The connector according to any one of claims 1-2, wherein the functional structure is a connecting structure.
4. The connector according to claim 3, wherein the connecting structure is a fastening hole in a base wall (3.15) or a connecting peg (3.16).
5. The connector according to claim 4, wherein the base wall (3.15) proximally protrudes from a body portion (3.1) of the connector.
6. The connector according to claim 5, wherein the base wall (3.15) is arranged offset from an insertion axis (20) of the connector.

7. The connector according to claim 1, wherein the functional portion is a fastener receiving portion (3.12) being arranged so that after the anchoring process it is distally of the proximal surface within the first object (1).
8. The connector according to claim 7, wherein the fastener receiving portion (3.12) is formed as a central distal protrusion extending distally from a body portion (3.1) of the connector.
9. The connector according to any one of claims 1-8, wherein the coupling-in face has a guiding indentation (3.6) being configured to cooperate with a corresponding protrusion of a sonotrode (6.6).
10. A connector (3) for being anchored in a first object (1) by mechanical vibration and by at least one pressing force, the connector comprising:

• a proximal contact face for coupling the at least one pressure force into the connector (3), • a body portion (31, 3.1) comprising the contact face, • a distal tube portion (3.2) distally protruding from the body portion (31, 3.1) and preferably providing a piercing and/or punching structure (3.4), and • a thermoplastic material in a solid state being liquefiable by the application of the mechanical vibration and the at least one pressing force.
11. The connector (3) according to claim 10, wherein the tube portion (3.2) is hollow and/or sleeve-like.
12. The connector (3) according to claim 10 or 11, wherein the tube portion (3.2) has a circular cross-section.
13. The connector according to any one of claims 10-12, wherein the tube portion is made of the thermoplastic material.
14. The connector according to any one of claims 10-13, wherein the body portion closes a proximal end of the tube portion.
15. The connector according to any one of claims 1-14, wherein the body portion is plate-like.
16. The connector (3) according to any one of claims 10-15, wherein the body portion laterally protrudes the tube portion (3.2) such that an outwardly protruding collar (3.5) is defined.
17. The connector (3) according to claim 16, wherein the outwardly protruding collar (3.5) serves as stop feature for the anchoring process.
18. The connector (3) according to any one of claims 10-17, wherein the piercing and/or punching structure (3.4) is blunt.
19. The connector (3) according to any one of claims 10-17, wherein the piercing and/or punching structure (3.4) is sharp.
